headline: Sensex and Nifty end lower as banking and pharma drag; IT stocks and Reliance Jio IPO news provide support.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Banking, pharma, and auto stocks witnessed significant selling pressure throughout the session.
Hot US consumer inflation data fueled expectations of further interest rate hikes, dampening global sentiment.
US FDA observations at a Zydus manufacturing plant weighed heavily on the pharmaceutical sector.
Strong performance and rallies in major IT stocks like Infosys and TCS helped cushion the overall market fall.
whatHappening: Reliance Jio announced its IPO subscription will open from October 21 to October 23, 2026.
Bajaj Consumer Care reported a strong Q2 performance with profit surging 66% year-on-year to Rs 70 crore.
The Nifty 50 closed below the 22,650 mark following a volatile trading session on October 14.
The Indian government is set to roll out the National Electricity Data Sharing framework later this month.
summary: Indian markets closed lower on October 14, with the Sensex dropping 252 points amid volatility and sector-specific pressure. While banking and pharma sectors struggled, the IT sector and news of Reliance Jio's upcoming IPO provided some relief to investors. Global cues remained weak following hot US inflation data and rising Treasury yields.
